props.author: Wild_Randomness
props.text: Yeah I think anything above 7 is noise, but over the past 10 months any trip below has been quickly met with index vol — doesn't mean one can buy 7dte puts and print but it is a decent signal to ease off the leveraged longs and have cash to put to work. One additional factor this time is COR1M which is now in deep July 2024 territory. N=1 sample size territory now.
